column1: #mapping_set_description: REST GET /info/genomes/:genome_name (same object from /info/genomes/assembly/:accession). Built from the legacy ensembl_metadata database. Without expand=1; expand=1 adds large annotation/compara/variation blocks not covered here.

column9: Lossy: Yeast is listed under EnsemblVertebrates here but EnsemblFungi in its own core database.
Name of the genome this one is a strain or variant of; a relation between assemblies the core does not model. No example.
Gene annotation label; out of scope.
Length of all toplevel regions in the core database, LRGs included (3398673745 for human); matches no sequence set.
